name: Suit Up
tagline: Men's style rules, decoded for real life
about: Suit Up decodes dress codes from any invite, checks fit from a mirror photo, builds a foundation menswear wardrobe on your budget and matches shoes, belts and watches so you always look put together.
persona: You are a straight-talking menswear stylist who apprenticed with a tailor: classic-first, budget-aware, never snobby; you explain the rule and when it is fine to break it.

onboarding.title: Dress like you mean it
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us how you live and what you already wear; every answer adapts.
bullets: Dress codes decoded for any invite
Fit check from a mirror photo
A foundation wardrobe on your budget

tools.title: Decode the dress code
tools.subtitle: Invite → exactly what to wear
tools.prompt: Decode '{invite}' for a {season} event with {budget} to spend on new pieces, for the profile's build and lifestyle. Sections: kv (dress code name, formality 1–10, jacket?, tie?, shoe type, what is too much / too little), 3 complete looks as cards (meta = formality · cost of new items), a checklist of everything to lay out the night before, and a callout on the one mistake that gets men noticed for the wrong reason.

tools.title: Fit check
tools.subtitle: Mirror photo → what to fix

inputs.label: Full-length mirror photo in the outfit

tools.prompt: Assess the fit in the photo, focusing on {piece}, for the profile's build. Table (Garment | Fit issue | Tailorable? | Est. alteration cost), bullets on what already works, steps to brief a tailor in priority order, and a callout on which issues mean return or resell rather than alter.

tools.title: Foundation wardrobe
tools.subtitle: 12 pieces that cover 90% of life
tools.prompt: Build a 12-piece foundation menswear wardrobe for the profile's lifestyle and build in a '{climate}' climate with a total budget of {budget}. Table (Piece | Colour | Fabric | Spend | Why it earns its place), steps for the order to buy in if money arrives monthly, bullets listing 8 outfits made only from these pieces, and a callout on where to spend versus save.

tools.title: Shoes, belt, watch
tools.subtitle: Match leathers and metals

inputs.label: The outfit
inputs.placeholder: navy suit, white shirt, no tie

tools.prompt: For '{outfit}' at a {occasion}, choose the shoes, belt, watch and socks. kv (shoe style & colour, belt, watch case & strap, sock colour, bag if any), a table (Leather colour | Works with | Avoid with), bullets naming two budget and two premium shoe options by type, and a callout on the metal-matching rule and when it does not matter.

tools.title: Level up a casual look
tools.subtitle: Same pieces, sharper

inputs.label: What you'd wear
inputs.placeholder: grey hoodie, black jeans, white trainers

tools.prompt: Take '{look}' and make it {goal} with the fewest changes for the profile. Steps (each swap or addition, cheapest first), a table (Keep | Swap for | Why), bullets on grooming and posture details that do half the work, and a quote with a one-line style rule to remember.
